items.title: Affirm is 'firing on all cylinders': COO talks perspective on US consumer
items.summary: Affirm stock (AFRM) is gaining on Friday after topping fiscal fourth quarter earnings expectations. Affirm COO Michael Linford — who was named as the company's next president — speaks with Brooke DiPalma about the company's results and the outlook surrounding the American consumer.

items.title: Trending: Take-Two Interactive price ascends as 'Grand Theft Auto VI' is teased
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Brooke DiPalma tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including PayPal (PYPL), Marvell Technology, Inc. (MRVL), and Take-Two Interactive (TTWO), whose price rose after a 30-minute preview of Grand Theft Auto VI video was released.

items.title: Why PayPal (PYPL) Shares Are Plunging Today
items.summary: Shares of digital payments platform PayPal (NASDAQ:PYPL) fell 12.7% in the afternoon session after Bloomberg News reported that a consortium led by payment processor Stripe and private-equity firm Advent International abandoned its $53 billion takeover pursuit of the company.
